memory.text: Frontline licensing peaked in August (17 in the week of 10 Aug), then eased to about 2 a week in October.
Holiday readiness rose about 4x from the week of 31 Aug (3 to 13 a week).
The store manager pilot was live every week: 204 signals, at least 10 a week.
Data loss prevention spiked in the week of 14 Sep (17 signals, against a usual 2).
Agent cost control came up every week: 69 signals, never below 3 a week.
